title: How many meals can a private chef cook in one visit?
body_html:
Most private chef visits in Dubai produce two to four finished meals for the days that follow. The number is not fixed: cooking time per dish, parallel prep, fridge and freezer space, and separate dietary handling all decide how much one visit can cover. Household visits start from AED 750 before 5% VAT, so the practical question is how to use the time well. The private chef service in Dubai page shows what a visit includes; this guide shows how many meals to plan for.

What decides how many meals one visit can cover

  • Cooking method. One-pot dishes, roasts and baked trays need little active attention; plated multi-component meals take the visit on their own.
  • Parallel prep. A soup can simmer while a marinade rests and a tray bakes, so three meals progress at once.
  • Your storage. Fridge shelf space, freezer capacity and containers cap the real count, not the chef.
  • Service style. A plated dinner for guests uses the visit; containers for the week multiply it.
  • Dietary handling. Halal-first is standard; separate allergen prep adds careful time.

A worked one-visit plan (hypothetical)

TimeTaskOutput
10:00Pantry and fridge check against the agreed menuShopping gaps closed
10:20Soup on the heat, sauce reduced, chicken marinatingThree meals moving at once
11:30Roast tray and vegetables into the ovenTonight's dinner underway
12:30Portion, cool and label containersFour labelled meals for the week
13:00Kitchen cleaned and left exactly as foundVisit complete

Two meals or four: how to choose

Your weekPlan the visit around
Family weeknightsThree or four simple containers, freeze one
Two working adultsTwo dinners plus breakfast prep
Entertaining this weekOne plated dinner; skip the containers
Mixed diets in one homeFewer meals, more shared components

Next step: send your household size, the meals you want covered and any dietary notes when you enquire through the private chef page — the brief is what makes one visit cover the week. Related reading: how long a private chef home visit takes and whether private chefs clean the kitchen afterwards.
